posts.title: Lunch date #2
posts.description: Some lunch dates are opulent and you have to use hairspray, shine your shoes, lint roll the jacket. This is a different kind of lunch date. Today we’re having black coffee and salmon soup on a plastic tray. I’ll sit across you, spread butter 5mm thick on my focaccia, and explain everything. posts.title: Ski week
posts.description: At the end of March there are a couple of weeks in Lapland where the sun stays high in the sky into the evening. The ground is covered in a plush layer of snow, like whipped cream on crushed Oreos. We prepared for our trip to the land of marshmallow winter. David skiied for hours every weekend. I did not.
